faq.a: KlipflowAI is an all-in-one AI platform for content creators and e-commerce brands. It combines Facebook Ad Spy, AI video and image generation, script writing, voice synthesis, avatar creation, automated social posting across 5 platforms, and one-click ad launching — all in one place.

faq.q: How does the AI Employee work for creators?
faq.a: You pick your niche and posting frequency once. KlipflowAI then automatically finds trending topics in your niche, writes the script, generates the visuals, adds a voiceover, and posts to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, and X on your schedule. You literally just check in to see your growth.
TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and X (Twitter). That's 5 platforms — more than any competitor on the market.

faq.q: What types of content can I create?
faq.a: Text-to-video, image-to-video, AI actor videos, UGC testimonial videos, AI image ads, script-to-video with voiceover, and more. Every format you need for social media and advertising.

faq.q: Do free trial videos have a watermark?
faq.a: Yes. Your 25 free trial tokens generate watermarked videos so you can experience the full quality before committing. The watermark disappears automatically the moment you subscribe to any paid plan.
Tokens are your generation credits. 1 video = 10 tokens, 1 image = 2 tokens. Every signup gets 25 free tokens — enough for 2 full videos. Top up anytime from $5 inside your dashboard.

faq.q: Is the Facebook Ad Spy legal?
faq.a: Yes. We use Meta's official Ads Library API which is publicly available and fully compliant with Meta's terms of service. No scraping, no violations.

faq.q: Can I upload my own actor for videos?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a photo of your talent and generate AI videos using their likeness. You'll confirm you own the rights to the image before generating.

faq.q: How is KlipflowAI different from other AI video tools?
faq.a: KlipflowAI is the only platform that combines ad intelligence, AI video and image generation, script writing, voice synthesis, avatar creation, automated 5-platform posting, AND one-click ad launching. Competitors only do one or two of these things.
Standard videos generate in 1-3 minutes. Pro and Agency plan users get priority processing, typically under 60 seconds.
Absolutely. No contracts, no hidden fees. Cancel with one click from your dashboard and you'll never be charged again.
Yes. If you can pick a niche and type a sentence, you can use KlipflowAI. No video editing, no design skills, no technical knowledge required whatsoever.
